# CHỦ ĐỀ 01: SELF-INTRODUCTION

| CHỦ ĐỀ 01: SELF-INTRODUCTION |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

| ![][image1]Mr Hung | Hi everyone, I'm Hung, and I'm the co-founder at Simple English Center here in Hanoi. Now, I'm married to my wife, Khanh Thu, and we have one amazing daughter. She is 5, very cute\! My hometown is Yen Bai, but I started my career in Hanoi. Actually, I have worked at SEC for 8 years and it has been great. It is a really good company. Sometimes my family, we go to my hometown to, well, visit my parents. I love Hanoi because it is convenient, and modern. Anyway, I love spending time with my family. And we enjoy delicious meals together every day. |
| :---: | :---- |

##### 

| Nice to meet you, I'm Thanh, and I'm 60 years old. I'm retired now. I used to work, but now I'm a housewife and I stay at home with my family. I live in a big house with my husband, my son, and his wife and kids. I take care of the house and cook for everyone. It’s tiring, but fun\! I really love my family because everyone helps each other. By the way, I am learning English so I can talk to my grandkids, and I want to travel around the world in the future. | ![][image2] Mrs Thanh |
| :---- | ----- |

##### 

| ![][image3] Minh | My name is Minh, and I’m 15 years old. I am studying at Viet Duc high school in Hanoi. In my free time, I enjoy playing games on my computer. My favorite games are Gacha games, Genshin Impact, for example. My favorite subjects are chemistry and math. At school, I have a lot of friends. They also enjoy games like me. It’s so fun, I like them a lot. So, my dream university is Hanoi University of Science and Technology, you know, Bach Khoa University. And I'm studying really hard for that. |
| ----- | :---- |

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Alice:** 	Hi there\! What’s your name?  
**Thanh:**	I’m Thanh. Nice to meet you\!  
**Alice:** 	Nice to meet you too, Thanh. Where do you live?  
**Thanh:**	I live in Gia Lai, in a big house with my husband and my son’s family — all under one roof\!  
**Alice:** 	That sounds fun.  
**Thanh:**	 It is, but sometimes it makes me feel tired\!  
**Alice:** 	And what do you do now?  
**Thanh:**	Well, I’m retired, and I’m a housewife. I take care of the house and cook for everyone.  
**Alice:** 	Really? You look young for your age. When did you retire?  
**Thanh:**	A few years ago. I’ve been enjoying home life since then.  
**Alice:** 	So, why are you learning English now?  
**Thanh:**	Because I want to talk to my grandkids more easily — and I’d love to travel the world one day.

# CHỦ ĐỀ 02: HOBBIES

| CHỦ ĐỀ 02: HOBBIES  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

Hi, I’m Lily. I want to talk a bit about my favorite hobby. To be honest, I’m crazy about playing Wild Rift. I enjoy playing it at home before going to bed. I like playing with my husband or, sometimes, with my friends. Two months ago, my husband got me into it, because he loves the game and wanted me to play with him. I didn’t like it at first, because it was hard, and I kept losing. But now, I play almost every day since it helps me relax after work.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Lily:** 	Hi\! What do you like doing for fun?  
**Max:** 	Wild Rift. I like playing Wild Rift. It's really fun.  
**Lily:** 	Oh, cool\! Where do you play?  
**Max:** 	Home. I play it at home before bed.   
**Lily:** 	That sounds relaxing\! Who do you play with?  
**Max:** 	My husband, or sometimes I play it with my friends.   
**Lily:** 	Oh, I see. Did you like playing it at first?  
**Max:** 	No. I didn't like it because it was hard.   
**Lily:** 	So, why do you play it now?  
**Max:** 	Because it helps me relax. I often play it after work or at night with my husband. We laugh a lot when playing it. How about you? Do you have any special hobbies?  
**Lily:** 	Yes, of course\! I’m interested in reading books every day. Oops\! It’s getting late. I have to go now\!  It was so nice talking with you\!  
**Max:** 	Thanks\! Happy to talk with you\! See you soon.

# CHỦ ĐỀ 03: FOOD & DRINK

| CHỦ ĐỀ 03: FOOD & DRINK  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

Hi everyone, I’m Dang. My favorite food is pho. It’s a delicious Vietnamese noodle soup with beef or chicken, but I prefer beef. To make Pho, we boil the bones for hours to make the broth, then add the noodles, meat and different vegetables. I usually eat it in the restaurant, but sometimes my mom makes it at home. I love eating Pho for breakfast or when I feel sad—it is a comfort food for me. When we go out to eat Pho, I often go with my dad or my cousin. We always add a bit of chili because we want the taste to be a little bit more spicy. The thing I love most about Pho is how it's tasty but not too salty or sweet. It’s just perfect. I think Pho is the best food in the world. A hot bowl of Pho will make your mouth water every time you see it.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Will:** 	Hey\! What’s your favorite food?  
**Đăng:** 	Pho. It’s my favorite food. I usually eat it at a restaurant, but sometimes at home too. How about you?  
**Will:** 	Nice\! I like pho too. So, when do you usually eat it?  
**Đăng:** 	For breakfast. I love eating pho in the morning, especially when I feel sad or tired. It really helps.  
**Will:** 	Aww, that’s sweet. Do you eat it alone or with someone?  
**Đăng:** 	I often eat it with my dad or my cousin. Do you eat pho with your family too?  
**Will:** 	Yeah, we sometimes have it together on weekends. How do you cook it at home?  
**Đăng:** 	We boil the bones to make the broth. It takes hours but the soup is so fresh. Do you ever cook it yourself?  
**Will:** 	Not yet, but I want to try\! Why do you like Pho?  
**Đăng:** 	Well, it just tastes perfect, not too salty, not too sweet. It’s even better with some iced tea.  
**Will:** 	Talking about Pho makes me hungry.  
**Đăng:** 	Me too\! Hey, how about we go and get some at my favorite place near my house\! It’s lunchtime anyway\!  
**Will:** 	Sounds good\! Let’s go\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 04: DESCRIBE PEOPLE \- APPEARANCE

| CHỦ ĐỀ 04: DESCRIBE PEOPLE \- APPEARANCE  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

This is my friend Kate. She's really nice\! She has shoulder-length hair, usually straight. When she goes to a party, she will make her hair wavy. Her face is quite round, and she has a bit of a baby face. But she is 36 years old this year\! She's about average height, 163 centimeters. She’s taller than me. Kate often wears clothes with a girly style, and her skin is quite pale. That girl looks very clean, like a traditional Vietnamese woman. She doesn't have any tattoos or ear piercings, and sometimes she'll wear light make-up. She has a really good smile, and she's always in good shape.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Ngoc:** 	Hey there\! How are things going? I want to introduce you to my friend, Kate.  
**Emma:** Kate? Sounds interesting\! What does she look like?  
**Ngoc:** Yeah, she's great. She has shoulder-length hair, usually straight.  
**Emma:** Oh, when does she style her hair differently?  
**Ngoc:** Yeah\! When she goes to a party, she’ll make her hair wavy. I wonder why…  
**Emma:** Why? I think she prefers wavy hair for special events. I think straight hair is fine, but wavy also looks great on her\!  
**Ngoc:** I think it's just for fun. Her face is quite round, and she has a bit of a baby face, even though she’s 36\! How tall is she? You guess.  
**Emma:** Dunno. How tall?  
**Ngoc:** She’s about average height, 163 centimeters. She’s taller than me, actually.  
**Emma:** 163 centimeters… That is not short. Hey, is that Kate over there?  
**Ngoc:** Where? Oh no, she often wears clothes with a girly style. And her skin is quite pale. The girl over there is more like a tomboy.  
**Emma:** Wow, so Kate is like a traditional Vietnamese woman.  
**Ngoc:** Do you want to see a photo of her?  
**Emma:** Yeah, let me see\! Aw, she has a really good smile.  
**Ngoc:** Yeah, I like her a lot. Anyway, it was fun chatting\! See ya\!  
**Emma:** Bye\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 05: EMOTIONS & CHARACTERISTIC

| CHỦ ĐỀ 05: EMOTIONS & CHARACTERISTIC  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

Layla, she is my best friend. She's incredibly hardworking, especially when she's aiming to get promoted. She's usually so kind and polite to everyone. However, she can be a bit stubborn when she believes in something strongly.  
For example, when we plan a trip, she's super enthusiastic, and she comes up with adventurous ideas. But then, if we hit a small problem, she might get a little anxious. Layla's also very honest, sometimes too honest\! She won't hesitate to tell you if your new shirt looks bad. And she's got a great sense of humor; she loves to tell funny jokes and always makes people laugh. She can be very generous too, but if someone is selfish to her, she gets pretty annoyed.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Halley:** Hello Sarah\! Is that your friend over there? What's she like?

**Sarah:** Yeah. Layla, that's her name. She's incredibly hardworking.

**Halley:** Wow, hardworking? What do you mean? What is her job?

**Sarah:** She is a scientist. She tries harder every day, especially when she wants to get promoted.

**Halley:** Gotcha. So, what’s she like outside of work?

**Sarah:** She's usually very kind and polite to everyone. But she can be stubborn sometimes.

**Halley:** Hmm. When does she usually show that side?

**Sarah:** When someone says something that she doesn’t agree with. Like when we travel, for example.

**Halley:** Interesting\! What is she like when you guys go on a trip?

**Sarah:** Okay, so, She's super enthusiastic when we plan trips. But then, if we hit a small problem, she might get a little anxious.

**Halley:** She sounds like quite a personality\! Thanks for telling me about her. Well, I need to go home now.

**Sarah:** Yeah me too. See you tomorrow\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 06: MY HOMETOWN

| CHỦ ĐỀ 06: MY HOMETOWN  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

I want to tell you about my hometown. I come from Da Nang, a beautiful coastal city in central Vietnam. It’s where I was born and raised, and I’ve lived there since I was a child. What makes my hometown special is its mix of modern life and natural beauty. You can enjoy fresh seafood by the beach or explore the peaceful mountains nearby. People here are friendly and always willing to help strangers. Many tourists visit Da Nang every year, especially in the summer when the weather is sunny and warm. My family still lives there, so I often go back whenever I have time. I really love Da Nang because it is a peaceful and lovely place to live.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Anna**: Hi Minh\! We’re talking about hometowns in class today. Can you tell me about yours?  
**Minh**: Sure\! I’m from Da Nang. It’s a beautiful coastal city in central Vietnam.

**Anna**: Nice\! So where exactly is it?  
**Minh**: It’s by the sea, right in the middle of Vietnam. It has both beaches and mountains.

**Anna**: Sounds amazing\! What’s special about your hometown?  
**Minh**: Well, it’s a mix of nature and city life. You can eat fresh seafood at the beach or go hiking in the mountains.

**Anna**: Cool\! Who do you live with there?  
**Minh**: My whole family still lives there. I moved to Hanoi for school, but I go back when I can.

**Anna**: I see. When is the best time to visit Da Nang?  
**Minh**: Definitely in the summer\! The weather is sunny and warm, and lots of tourists come.

**Anna**: Why do you like it so much?  
**Minh**: People are super friendly, and life there is relaxing. It taught me to slow down and enjoy simple things.

**Anna**: How often do you visit your hometown?  
**Minh**: Maybe 2 or 3 times a year. I miss it a lot\!

**Anna:** Thanks for sharing, Minh\! I really want to visit Da Nang now.  
**Minh:** You should\! I can show you around next time you go\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 07: TRANSPORT

| CHỦ ĐỀ 07: TRANSPORT  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

In Vietnam, most people use motorbikes for their daily commute. It's very convenient for getting around on the streets and avoiding traffic. When I go to work, I ride a bike or my motorbike, and the traffic is light in the morning, which is good. We often see many underbones driving around. Sometimes, the roads can be a bit crowded, but mostly it's a smooth journey.  
However, things are changing fast\! More people are buying electric vehicles and electric cars now because they are more eco-friendly. The Vietnamese government is supporting electric vehicles over gasoline ones. Starting in 2026, gasoline motorbikes will be banned in some central areas of big cities. This means many motorbikes won’t be able to go to certain places. This should help reduce traffic and make our trips easier. It’s a big change for transport here\!

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

Sally: Hello Lam\! You are late today. The meeting finished a few minutes ago.

Mr Lam: Oh no… Sorry, traffic was crazy today. I went to work by motorbike and I was in a traffic jam.

Sally: So, sounds like motorbikes are super popular for daily commute, right?

Mr Lam: Yes, they are\! They're really convenient for the streets here.

Sally: When do you usually ride yours?

Mr Lam: I use my underbone to go anywhere. People in Vietnam nowadays use electric vehicles more, but there are still a lot of people like me.

Sally: That makes sense. And you said the traffic was heavy this morning. Is it always a smooth journey?

Mr Lam: Mostly, yes\! Sometimes the roads can be crowded at rush hour, but it's usually okay.

Sally: And you talked about electric vehicles. Electric cars are getting more popular in Vietnam, right?

Mr Lam: Not only cars. People are buying electric cars and also electric motorbikes, scooters.

Sally: Wow, interesting. How do you think that will affect the traffic congestion?

Mr Lam: I think it will make the streets less heavy and hopefully, our journey will be better. 

Mr Lam: Yes, me too. Oh well, I need to start working now.

Sally: Yeah me too. Have a nice day.

# CHỦ ĐỀ 08: TRAVELING

| CHỦ ĐỀ 08: TRAVELING  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

Hi\! I’d like to talk about my most memorable trip to Da Nang. It's a beautiful city in Vietnam. I went there last summer with my family for a vacation. We wanted some relaxation\! We booked a flight to get there, and we stayed at a hotel near the beach. We loved exploring and sightseeing every day. We also tried a lot of amazing local cuisine, which was really eye-opening. I used my camera to take photos of everything we saw. I was a bit tired but happy. We even bought some nice souvenirs for our friends at home. It was truly a memorable time.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

A:  Hi there\! I heard you had a memorable trip. Where did you go?

B: Da Nang. My most memorable trip was to Da Nang. It's a beautiful city in Vietnam.

A: Sounds lovely\! When did you go and who did you go with?

B: I went there last summer with my family cause we wanted some relaxation. 

A: How about where you stayed?

B: Yeah, Hotel... We stayed at a beautiful hotel near the beach. We loved exploring and sightseeing every day. It was eye-opening, and I used my camera to take photos of everything. Do you like taking photos when you travel?

A: Yes, I take tons\! Oh, what about the food? Did you try anything special?

B: Cuisine? Sure\!  We tried a lot of amazing local cuisine, like bun cha ca, mi quang, and fresh seafood ….

A: That’s great\! So, how did you feel about the trip overall?

B: Happy. I was a bit tired but really happy. We bought some nice souvenirs for our friends at home. 

A: Wow\! It was great to hear about your vacation. Thank you so much for sharing\! Catch you later\!

B: You’re welcome\! See ya\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 09: WEATHER

| CHỦ ĐỀ 09: WEATHER  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

I live in Hanoi, and we have four seasons here. Spring is warm, and it often drizzles a little. Flowers bloom everywhere, and the city becomes a picturesque and breathtaking scenery.  
Summer is my favorite season because it is the perfect time to hit the beach or take an opportunity to explore new places, relax, and create cherished memories with my family. The temperature can get boiling, and the air is very humid, so I sweat a lot.  
Autumn is beautiful because the weather is sunny and breezy, and sometimes it is a bit chilly. The clear sky and golden leaves make the city look so romantic.  
Winter is cold, but it is never snowy. Sometimes we have a cold spell that makes me shiver, so I wear a coat. I enjoy drinking something warm and chatting with friends during this time.  
Hanoi has many kinds of weather all year round, and that makes living here very exciting.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Peter:** Hello Lan\! I heard you live in Hanoi. What’s the weather like there?  
**Lan:** Hi Peter\! Yes, I live in Hanoi. The weather is exciting because we have four seasons\!

**Peter:** Four seasons? That’s interesting\! Can you tell me more?  
**Lan:** Sure\! In spring, it’s **warm** and often **drizzles** a little. Flowers bloom everywhere, and the city becomes so beautiful.

**Peter:** Sounds lovely\! What about summer? Is it hot?  
**Lan:** Yes, summer can get **boiling** and very **humid**, but I love it because it’s the perfect time to hit the beach or explore new places with my family.

**Peter:** That’s nice\! How about autumn and winter?  
**Lan:** Autumn is **sunny** and **breezy**, sometimes a bit **chilly**. Winter is **cold**, but it’s never **snowy**. Sometimes we have a **cold spell** that makes me shiver, so I wear a coat.

**Peter:** Which season is your favourite?  
**Lan:** Definitely summer\! I have more free time and can create cherished memories with my family.

**Peter:** Wow, Hanoi sounds like a great place with many kinds of weather\!  
**Lan:** Yes\! You should visit one day and experience all four seasons\!

3. #### **Mẫu câu**

| **What**  | The weather in my hometown is usually (hot / warm / cool / cold). | The weather in my hometown is usually warm. |  |
|  | It’s (sunny / rainy / cloudy / windy / humid / foggy) most of the time. | It’s sunny most of the time. |  |
|  | We often have (rain / snow / fog / storms / sunshine). | We often have sunshine. |  |
|  | The temperature is around (10 / 20 / 30\) degrees. | The temperature is around 30 degrees. |  |
|  |  It feels (chilly / hot / warm / fresh) outside. | It feels chilly outside. |  |
|  |  The sky is usually (clear / grey / cloudy / blue). | The sky is usually clear. |  |
| **Where** | In (Hanoi / my hometown), it’s (hot / cool / humid) in (season). | In Hanoi, it’s humid in summer. |  |
|  | Near the (sea / mountains / countryside), it’s often (windy / cool / foggy). | Near the sea, it’s often windy. |  |
|  | In the (north / south / central) of my country, it’s (warm / rainy / dry). | In the north of my country, it’s cold in winter. |  |
|  | My hometown is (by the sea / in the mountains / in a valley), so it’s (cool / windy / rainy). | My hometown is in the mountains, so it’s cool. |  |
|  | The weather is different in (the city / the countryside). | The weather is cooler in the countryside. |  |
| **When (Thời gian xảy ra)** | In (spring / summer / autumn / winter), it is (hot / cool / rainy / dry). | In autumn, it is cool and windy. |  |
|  | The rainy season starts in (month). | The rainy season starts in May. |  |
|  | We often get (storms / snow / heavy rain) in (month / season). | We often get storms in July. |  |
|  | The temperature rises/falls in (month / season). | The temperature falls in December. |  |
|  |  It’s (hot / humid / dry) during the day, but (cool / cold) at night. | It’s hot during the day, but cool at night. |  |
|  | The weather changes a lot in (season). | The weather changes a lot in spring. |  |
| **Why** | It’s (rainy / sunny / windy) because of the (monsoon / season / location). | It’s rainy because of the monsoon. |  |
|  | It feels (cold / hot) because of the (wind / sunshine / humidity). | It feels hot because of the sunshine. |  |
|  | We have (snow / rain) because it’s (winter / summer / the rainy season). | We have rain because it’s summer. |  |
|  | The temperature (rises / falls) because of the (heatwave / cold spell). | The temperature falls because of the cold spell. |  |
|  |  It’s unusual weather because (reason). | It’s unusual weather because it snowed in April. |  |
| **Who**  | People in my hometown (love / enjoy / dislike) this weather because (reason). | People in my hometown enjoy sunny days because they can go outside. |  |
|  | Tourists visit (place) when it’s (sunny / cool / warm). | Tourists visit Da Lat when it’s cool. |  |
|  | Farmers need (rain / sunshine) to (grow rice / plant vegetables). | Farmers need rain to grow rice. |  |
|  | Children enjoy (snowy / windy / sunny) weather for (playing / flying kites / swimming). | Children enjoy windy weather for flying kites. |  |
|  | Elderly people dislike (cold / hot / humid) weather. | Elderly people dislike cold weather. |  |
|  | Locals prepare for (storms / rain / snow) by (activity). | Locals prepare for storms by securing their houses. |  |
| **How**  | It’s (hot / cold / cool / humid) in (place) during (season). | It’s humid in Hanoi during summer. |  |
|  | The weather changes (quickly / slowly / a lot). | The weather changes quickly. |  |
|  | (Sunny / Rainy / Cold) weather makes people feel (happy / sleepy / tired). | Rainy weather makes people feel sleepy. |  |
|  | People deal with (heat / cold / rain) by (drinking cold water / wearing a coat / using an umbrella). | People deal with cold by wearing a coat. |  |
|  | The weather affects (travel / farming / sports) in (a good way / a bad way). | The weather affects farming in a good way. |  |
|  |  People enjoy this weather by (going to the park / having picnics / going to the beach). | People enjoy this weather by going to the beach. |  |

# CHỦ ĐỀ 10: HOUSE

| CHỦ ĐỀ 10: HOUSE  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

You know, my dream house isn’t big or fancy. I just want a small, tidy place that feels cozy. I’d love to live somewhere quiet, maybe near the countryside but still close enough to the city. One day—maybe when I pay off a mortgage—I’ll move there with my family.  
It’ll have two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a warm living room with a comfy sofa, a little lamp, and a big window with soft curtains. The kitchen will have a cooker, a fridge, and a sink, nothing too big. I’d hang a family picture on the wall, and maybe put a mirror in the hallway.  
Outside? A small garden and a little balcony where I can drink coffee in the morning. Oh—and a garage for my bike. That’s it. Simple, but it’d be home.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Linda:** Hey\! Can I ask you something? **What does your dream house look like?**

**You:** You know, my dream house isn’t big or fancy. I just want a small, tidy place that feels cozy.

**Linda:** That sounds nice\! **Where do you want it to be?**

**You:** Somewhere quiet, maybe near the countryside but still close to the city. Peaceful but convenient.

**Linda:** What about the inside? **How many rooms would it have?**

**You:** It’ll have two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a warm living room with a comfy sofa, a little lamp, and a big window with soft curtains.

**Linda:** That sounds lovely\! **How will it be set up or decorated**?

**You:** I’d keep it simple—soft colors, some plants, a family photo on the wall.

**Linda:** **What about outside?**

**You:** Just a small garden and a little balcony where I can enjoy my morning coffee. Oh, and a garage for my bike\!

**Linda:** I can totally picture it\! Sounds like a perfect home.I hope you get to live there one day\!

**You:** Thanks\! Me too. It’s simple, but it’d really feel like home.

# CHỦ ĐỀ 11: HEALTH

| CHỦ ĐỀ 11: HEALTH  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

Last year, I got really sick after eating at a street food place. I think I had food poisoning because I felt terrible. I had a bad stomachache, a bit of fever, and kept vomiting. It started at night when I was at home, and it got worse in the morning. My mom helped me a lot—she gave me water and told me to eat bland, easily digestible foods. I also took some medicine and tried to rest all day. After two days, I started to feel a bit better. Now I always try to eat healthy food and clean my hands before I eat. That was one of the worst times I felt under the weather.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Liam:** Hey\! Look at that street food stall\! Do you want to try some?

**You:** Hmm… last year, I got really sick after eating at a street food place. I had a bad stomachache, a bit of fever, and kept vomiting. It started at night when I was at home, and it got worse in the morning.

**Liam:** Oh my gosh\! That sounds awful\! Who helped you through that?

**You:** My mom helped me a lot—she gave me water and told me to eat bland, easily digestible foods.

**Liam:** That was really kind of her. Did you do anything else to feel better?

**You:** Yes, I also took some medicine and tried to rest all day.

**Liam:** I see… How long did it take until you started feeling better?

**You:** After two days, I started to feel a bit better.

**Liam:** That must have been horrible\!

**You:** Yes, it really was. Now I always try to eat healthy food, clean my hands before I eat, and I avoid eating street snacks in places that don’t look clean.

**Liam:** I think that stall looks clean enough. Do you want to try it?

**You:** Ok, let’s give it a go\!

# CHỦ ĐỀ 12: JOB

| CHỦ ĐỀ 12: JOB  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

I’m a pickleball coach. I work in a sports center, and I coach both kids and adults. I usually work part-time, mostly in the afternoon and on weekends. I chose this career because I love sports and I enjoy teaching. It’s fun to help people learn something new. I often work with other coaches and staff—we’re like a small team. My main tasks are to plan lessons, help customers, and give feedback during games. I also organize matches and sometimes send emails to parents. The job can be a bit competitive, but it’s also really people-oriented, and I like talking to students. I think this job helps me improve my communication and problem solving skills, and I’ve learned a lot of new knowledge through training too.

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Anna:** Hey Chris\! What do you do for work?

**Chris:** Oh, I’m a pickleball coach. I work at a sports center, and I coach both kids and adults.

**Anna:** Wow, that sounds interesting\! Do you work full-time or part-time?

**Chris:** I usually work part-time, mostly in the afternoon and on weekends.

**Anna:** That’s nice. Why did you choose to be a coach?

**Chris:** Well, I chose this career because I love sports, and I really enjoy teaching. It’s fun to help people learn something new.

**Anna:** Sounds great\! Do you work alone, or do you have a team?

**Chris:** I often work with other coaches and staff—we’re like a small team.

**Anna:** What kind of tasks do you usually do in your job?

**Chris:** My main tasks are to plan lessons, help customers, and give feedback during games. I also organize matches and sometimes send emails to parents.

**Anna:** That sounds like a busy job\! Is it a competitive environment?

**Chris:** It can be a bit competitive, but it’s also really people-oriented. I enjoy talking to the students and helping them improve.

**Anna:** That sounds really rewarding. Has your job helped you improve any skills?

**Chris:** Definitely\! I think this job has helped me improve my communication and problem-solving skills. Plus, I’ve learned a lot of new knowledge through training too.

**Anna:** Wow, you’ve really grown in your career. I’m sure your students love you\!

**Chris:** Thanks, Anna\! I really enjoy what I do.

# CHỦ ĐỀ 13: FUTURE GOALS

| CHỦ ĐỀ 13: FUTURE GOALS  |
| :---: |

1. #### **Bài đọc và hội thoại**

##### **1.1. Bài đọc**

My future goals are having a beautiful and smart wife, two kids, a three-story house, and a car when I am thirty. Now I am twenty-two, and I am just a clerk. However, I have a small online shop. I have a plan to achieve my goals. I often improve my knowledge and skills by working and learning hard. I try my best at work. I read books every morning. Sometimes, I feel stressed, but then I think of my goals, which motivates me a lot. I know that it is hard to achieve my goals, but I will never give up\!

##### **1.2. Hội thoại:**

**Jane:** Hey\! Long time no see. How have you been?

Peter: Hi\! I’ve been fine, just busy with work and planning for my future.

Jane: Oh really? What are your future goals?

Peter: Well, my future goals are to have a beautiful and smart wife, two kids, a three-story house, and a car.

Jane: Wow, that’s quite a plan\! When do you hope to achieve all of this?

Peter: By the time I’m thirty. I want to have all these things by then.

Jane: By the way, how old are you now?

Peter: I’m twenty-two. Right now, I’m just a clerk, but I also run a small online shop.

Jane: So, how do you work towards them?

Peter: I try to improve my knowledge and skills every day. I work hard, and I read books every morning.

Jane: Sounds great\! But don’t you feel stressed sometimes?

Peter: Of course, I do. But whenever I feel down, I think about my goals, and that keeps me motivated.

Jane: I really admire your determination.

Peter: Thanks\! I know it won’t be easy, but I’ll never give up.

Jane: I’m sure you’ll succeed. Let’s catch up again soon and see how things are going.

Peter: Thanks for the encouragement. See you later\!

|  | I plan to (improve my skills/join a club/do an internship). | I plan to do an internship. |  |
|  | I will try to (work hard/save money/practice every day). | I will try to save money. |  |
|  | My family can support me by (encouraging me/helping with expenses). | My family can support me by encouraging me. |  |
|  | I believe I will succeed if (I keep trying/I never give up). | I believe I will succeed if I never give up. |  |
|  | I know I am successful when (I reach my goal/I make a difference). | I know I am successful when I make a difference. |  |
